The '''Steering Committee''' was an [[Advisor/Legends|advisory]] body of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], formed by select [[Politics|politicians]], [[Currency/Legends|financiers]] representing several organizations and [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], such as [[Sestina]], and the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]], the elite of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] and the [[Trade Federation Directorate]], as well as [[Narro Sienar]] and other [[Starship/Legends|ship]] designers. The committee met periodically on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], to assure the swift passage of corporate-friendly legislation, fix the price of commodities such as [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]], [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and several other materials. While, keeping [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], [[Death|killed]] at an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] on the [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|Lodge of the Order of the Canted Circle]] by [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The steering committee appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
